operative_text:
Section 1 (new section in chapter 202 of NRS): 1. Except as otherwise provided in this section, a person shall not carry or possess a firearm on a covered premises if an owner or operator of a covered premises or an agent thereof does all of the following:
Section 1 (new section in chapter 202 of NRS): (a) Elects to prohibit a person from carrying or possessing a firearm on the covered premises.
Section 1 (new section in chapter 202 of NRS): 2. Except as otherwise provided in this section, a person who violates subsection 1 is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.
Section 1 (new section in chapter 202 of NRS): 3. Before making an arrest pursuant to this section, a peace officer must provide the person an opportunity to comply with the policies and procedures of the covered premises.
Section 1 (new section in chapter 202 of NRS): (b) Does not apply to: (1) A peace officer;
Section 1 (new section in chapter 202 of NRS): (4) A person who has the written consent of the owner or operator of a covered premises or an agent thereof to carry or possess a firearm on the covered premises.
Section 1 (new section in chapter 202 of NRS): (b) “Covered premises” means any real property containing a licensed gaming establishment which is owned or operated by a person who holds a nonrestricted license, as defined in NRS 463.0177, or any affiliate thereof.
